_comment: Copy this file to model_config.json and fill in real values. Top-level keys are model names (model-key); any key starting with 'embedding' is reserved and never used as the default chat model. See README.md > Configuration.

embedding._comment: OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings endpoint (vLLM / SGLang / TEI / OpenAI). This is the DEFAULT embedding entry the engine looks for. api_key may be 'EMPTY' for a local server that ignores it.

embedding_local._comment: Alternative: load embedding weights IN-PROCESS via sentence-transformers (no HTTP server). Select with --embedding-key embedding_local. Requires the optional 'sentence-transformers' + 'torch' dependencies (see requirements.txt). 'model' is a HF repo id or a local weights directory.
